import numpy as np

def move(terrain, start, duration_s, n_runs, seed):
    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
    n_steps = 60
    dt = duration_s / (n_steps - 1)
    points = np.empty((n_runs, n_steps, 3), dtype=float)
    # Initialize first points
    points[:, 0, 0] = start[0]
    points[:, 0, 1] = start[1]
    points[:, 0, 2] = 0.0

    # Bearings all near northeast (45 deg) with small angular noise +-15 deg
    angle_center = np.pi/4
    angle_noise = (rng.random(n_runs) - 0.5)*np.deg2rad(30)
    bearings = angle_center + angle_noise

    ok = np.ones(n_runs, dtype=bool)

    lat = points[:, 0, 0]
    lon = points[:, 0, 1]
    sec = points[:, 0, 2]

    for step in range(1, n_steps):
        # Clamp current pos inside terrain box
        lat, lon = terrain.clamp(lat, lon)
        slope = terrain.slope_deg(lat, lon)
        elev = terrain.elev(lat, lon)
        # d_elev along bearing is estimated forward by one cell in bearing direc
        # Approximate horizontal offset by 30 m along bearing
        bearing = bearings.copy()
        dist = terrain.cell_m
        lat_f, lon_f = terrain.offset(lat, lon, bearing, dist)
        elev_f = terrain.elev(lat_f, lon_f)
        d_elev_m = elev_f - elev
        d_horiz_m = dist
        speed_ms = terrain.tobler_speed_ms(d_elev_m, d_horiz_m)
        move_dist = speed_ms * dt

        # Displace along bearing by move_dist
        lat_new, lon_new = terrain.offset(lat, lon, bearing, move_dist)

        # Reject moves outside box => clamp and mark run not ok
        inside = terrain.inside(lat_new, lon_new)
        ok = ok & inside
        lat_new, lon_new = terrain.clamp(lat_new, lon_new)

        sec_new = sec + dt

        points[:, step, 0] = lat_new
        points[:, step, 1] = lon_new
        points[:, step, 2] = sec_new

        lat = lat_new
        lon = lon_new
        sec = sec_new

    # Ensure time nondecreasing (already guaranteed)
    return points, ok
